# PowerFootball-2D — Semantic Repository Map & RAG Router

**Godot 4.7 · GDScript 2.0 · Manager-Only Quick-Sim Football Management Game**
"Football Manager with a living world." You manage the club; `QuickSimEngine` resolves the football.

> **Pivot notice:** the project is manager-only. Matches are fully resolved by `shared/QuickSimEngine.gd`,
> a statistical simulator — there is no player control, real-time match engine, ball physics, or per-frame AI.
> The former 22-player physics game is archived under `legacy/` (see section 3) and is preserved as reference.

---

## 1. Vision & Architectural Invariants

<core_invariants>
- **docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md** — Canonical single source of truth: engine lock, 3-layer simulation stack, choke points, and current laws.
- **docs/GRAPHIFY_LIFECYCLE.md** — Canonical Graphify lifecycle, git hooks, update mechanics, and enforcement matrix.
- **docs/API_SURFACE.md** — Auto-generated public API surface map across all live scripts, exports, signals, and methods.
- **docs/ANTI_PATTERNS.md** — Curated anti-pattern and hallucination corpus for autonomous agent reasoning.
- **docs/MATH_SOLVERS.md** — Ground-truth mathematical solvers catalog with exact formulas, proofs, and GDScript reference code.
- **docs/SYMBOLS.json** — Complete line-indexed symbol map across all classes, methods, properties, and signals.
- **docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json** — Static bidirectional dependency DAG and blast radius graph.
- **POWERFOOTBALL_MASTER_VISION.md** — Historical pre-pivot design vision. Read its `## Pivot Note` first; the rest is a record of the abandoned real-time architecture, not current guidance.
- **ROADMAP.md** — Tactical `[ ]`/`[x]` feature checklist across 5 development phases, re-based on the manager-only pivot.
- **docs/course_implementation_specification.md** — Course-derived reference specification (READ-ONLY): FSMs, formulas, gotchas.
- **AGENTS.md** — Canonical shared policy & architecture guide for all AI agents across the repository.
- **AGENTS_ERRATA.md** — Compact migration index & pending rule proposal staging.
- **docs/agent-errata/README.md** — Topic-specific errata index & reading guide.
- **docs/architecture/hubs/career-manager.md** — Architecture hub map for the live `CareerManager` career world.
- **docs/json-schema.md** — Formal specification for the external JSON club/player/manager/referee/staff databases.
</core_invariants>

## 2. Three-Layer Simulation Stack (Semantic Routing)

<layer_1_career_world>
### Layer 1 — Career World
Persistent club world: the single live `CareerSaveData`, the league database behind it, the day loop, transfers,
contracts, finances, morale, board confidence, scouting, youth and season progression.

- **autoloads/CareerManager.gd** — Owns the ONLY live `CareerSaveData`. Day loop, fixture dispatch (`simulate_next_fixture()`), result application (`_apply_fixture_result()`), transfers, contracts, injuries, season rollover.
- **autoloads/DataLoader.gd** — JSON ingestion for players, teams and leagues; per-slot persistence via `save_league()`.
- **autoloads/ManagerLoader.gd** — Manager database JSON loader.
- **autoloads/RefereeLoader.gd** — Referee database JSON loader.
- **autoloads/StaffLoader.gd** — Staff database JSON loader.
- **shared/CareerProgressionEngine.gd** — Career growth, ageing and progression math.
- **shared/career/CareerSaveData.gd** — Root career save aggregate.
- **shared/career/CareerSerializer.gd** — Versioned JSON save/load across 3 slots.
- **shared/career/CareerDate.gd** — Career calendar date arithmetic.
- **shared/career/CompetitionData.gd** — League/knockout competition state, table, cup rounds, tie resolution.
- **shared/career/FixtureData.gd** — Fixture record and result container.
- **shared/career/LeagueTableRow.gd** — Standings row model.
- **shared/career/ClubFinances.gd** — Budgets, ledger, amortisation, gate receipts.
- **shared/career/ContractData.gd** — Player contracts and expiry.
- **shared/career/TransferMarket.gd** — Transfer windows, listing and negotiation flow.
- **shared/career/TransferOffer.gd** — Individual transfer bid state.
- **shared/career/ScoutingNetwork.gd** — Scouting assignments and knowledge accumulation.
- **shared/career/ScoutReport.gd** — Uncertainty-based scout report.
- **shared/career/YouthAcademy.gd** — Youth intake and academy progression.
- **shared/career/TrainingSchedule.gd** — Training intensity, fatigue and daily injury risk.
- **shared/career/PlayerCareerState.gd** — Per-player career state (condition, injuries, development).
- **shared/career/PlayerDevelopmentEngine.gd** — Attribute growth and decline.
- **shared/career/MoraleEngine.gd** — Morale, form and reputation drift; career-level relationship effects.
- **shared/career/ManagerCareerProfile.gd** — Manager career record and reputation.
- **shared/career/BoardState.gd** — Board expectations, confidence, requests and sacking.
- **shared/career/InboxEngine.gd** — Inbox generation from career events.
- **shared/career/InboxItem.gd** — Individual inbox message/decision.
- **shared/career/RelationshipData.gd** — Career-level player relationship graph.
- **shared/career/WorldEvent.gd** — Club-world event record consumed by the narrative layer.
- **shared/career/CareerThemePalette.gd** — Career UI theme palette helper.
- **shared/TeamData.gd** — Team identity, tactics, lineup indices, colours, stadium.
- **shared/PlayerData.gd** — Persistent player attributes, traits and derived fields.
- **shared/LeagueData.gd** — League structure, season standings and division parameters.
- **shared/ManagerData.gd** — Manager profile, tactical preferences, personality traits.
- **shared/RefereeData.gd** — Referee strictness, consistency, composure and card bias.
- **shared/StaffData.gd** — Staff roles and coaching/physio/scouting quality.
- **shared/TeamManagementData.gd** — Lineup management, roster changes and bench assignments.
- **shared/NationDatabase.gd** — Nationality database helper.
- **shared/FormationLibrary.gd** — Standard formations (4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2, etc.).
- **shared/FormationRegistry.gd** — Formation catalog and lookup helper.
- **shared/PlayerRoleConfig.gd** — Data-driven role tuning resource.
- **shared/roles/*.tres** — 12 role tuning resources (GK, CB, LB/RB, DM/CDM/CM/AM/LM/RM/LW/RW/ST).
- **data/league.json**, **data/players.json**, **data/managers.json**, **data/referees.json**, **data/staff.json** — Authoritative JSON databases.
</layer_1_career_world>

<layer_2_quick_sim_match>
### Layer 2 — Quick-Sim Match
The entire match is a statistical simulation. There is no per-frame loop: a fixture is resolved analytically and
stochastically, then published into the scoreboard and stats trackers.

- **shared/QuickSimEngine.gd** — Probability model (bivariate Poisson / Dixon-Coles) + stochastic match simulation. `calculate_probabilities()` returns the analytical outcome distribution; `simulate_match()` returns score, chronological goal/card timeline, team stats, advanced Moneyball analytics, and per-player events and ratings; `apply_to_match_stats_tracker()` publishes the result into `GameManager` + `MatchStatsTracker`.
- **shared/PlayerRatingCalculator.gd** — 1.0–10.0 performance ratings from per-player match events.
- **shared/UtilityMath.gd** — Shared statistical/geometric math helpers.
- **autoloads/MatchStatsTracker.gd** — Per-player and per-team match event accumulator (shots, possession, cards, offsides, ratings).
- **autoloads/GameManager.gd** — Thin scoreboard shell only: `TEAM_A`, `TEAM_B`, `enum MatchPhase { PREGAME, FULL_TIME }`, `current_phase`, `score`, `match_time`, `match_duration`, `half_duration_real_sec`, `simulated_match_time`, `set_half_duration()`.
</layer_2_quick_sim_match>

<layer_3_narrative_presentation>
### Layer 3 — Narrative & Presentation
Event log, press reactions, and the entire manager UI. Reacts to simulation state; never mutates it.

- **autoloads/GameEvents.gd** — Signal bus; the ONLY cross-system event route. Carries 11 signals: `formation_changed`, `lineup_changed`, and the career signals `career_started`, `career_day_advanced`, `career_advance_halted`, `career_inbox_changed`, `career_match_ready`, `career_result_recorded`, `career_season_ended`, `career_manager_sacked`, `world_event_logged`.
- **autoloads/WorldEventLog.gd** — Club-world history; feeds `PressOffice`.
- **entities/manager/PressOffice.gd** — Press narrative generation: pre/post-match quotes, transfer speculation, injury updates, touchline reactions.
- **ui/manager_mode/ManagerModeRoot.gd** — FM-style career shell; the career UI never leaves this root.
- **ui/manager_mode/ManagerCreationScreen.gd** — New-manager creation and club selection.
- **ui/manager_mode/** panels — `OverviewPanel`, `SquadPanel`, `TacticsPanel`, `TrainingPanel`, `TransfersPanel`, `ScoutingPanel`, `FinancesPanel`, `BoardPanel`, `CalendarPanel`, `FixturesPanel`, `LeaguePanel`, `InboxPanel`, `StaffPanel`, `CareerPanel`, plus `ContractNegotiationModal` and `CareerTheme`.
- **ui/MainMenu.gd** — Main entry screen; exactly three buttons: **Manager Mode**, **Options**, **Quit**.
- **ui/OptionsMenu.gd** — Settings (including match half duration).
- **ui/MatchStatsUI.gd** — Full-time match summary, team stats and player ratings.
- **ui/QuickSimModal.gd** — Quick-sim result/probability presentation.
- **ui/SplashScreen.gd** — Boot splash; `project.godot` main scene.
</layer_3_narrative_presentation>

---

## 3. Live File Tree (source of truth)

```
project.godot                     # Main scene: res://ui/SplashScreen.tscn; 9 autoloads
autoloads/                        # 9 autoloads, in boot order:
  GameEvents.gd                   #   signal bus
  GameManager.gd                  #   scoreboard shell
  MatchStatsTracker.gd            #   match stats accumulator
  DataLoader.gd                   #   players/teams/leagues JSON + save_league()
  RefereeLoader.gd                #   referees JSON
  ManagerLoader.gd                #   managers JSON
  StaffLoader.gd                  #   staff JSON
  WorldEventLog.gd                #   club-world event log
  CareerManager.gd                #   live CareerSaveData owner
shared/
  QuickSimEngine.gd               # LAYER 2 core statistical match engine
  PlayerRatingCalculator.gd
  UtilityMath.gd
  CareerProgressionEngine.gd
  TeamData.gd  PlayerData.gd  LeagueData.gd  ManagerData.gd
  RefereeData.gd  StaffData.gd  TeamManagementData.gd  NationDatabase.gd
  FormationLibrary.gd  FormationRegistry.gd  PlayerRoleConfig.gd
  career/                         # 24-file career data model + engines
  roles/                          # 12 role .tres resources
entities/
  manager/PressOffice.gd          # only live entity script
ui/
  SplashScreen.*  MainMenu.*  OptionsMenu.*  MatchStatsUI.*  QuickSimModal.*
  manager_mode/                   # ManagerModeRoot, ManagerCreationScreen, panels, theme
data/                             # league.json, players.json, managers.json, referees.json, staff.json
docs/                             # CORE_INVARIANTS, API_SURFACE, SYMBOLS.json, DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json, ...
legacy/                           # ARCHIVE — do not treat as live (see below)
tools/                            # verification linters, fuzzers, generators
scripts/                          # DB build helpers
```

<legacy_archive>
### legacy/ — Archived Real-Time Layer (reference only)

Not deleted and not imported: `legacy/.gdignore` makes Godot and every verification tool skip the tree.
It holds the abandoned real-time 22-player match engine:

- `legacy/entities/{ball,player,goalkeeper,referee}/` — ball state machines, player kinematic controller and decision brain, mood/trust systems, officiating and offside detection.
- `legacy/entities/manager/` — in-match manager director and visuals.
- `legacy/pitch/` — pitch scene, boundaries, goal zones, camera, minimap, set-piece and shootout coordinators.
- `legacy/autoloads/` — spatial cache, match telemetry, and input helper autoloads.
- `legacy/shared/` — collision layer constants, pass utility scoring, formation anchor math, and the career→match player factory.
- `legacy/ui/` — in-match HUD, floating action text, touchline bubbles, match intro, kick-off menu, formation diagram, plus `pregame/`, `pause/` and `tactics/` screens.

Do not reference these paths from live code. They are preserved as design reference for future `QuickSimEngine` depth work.
</legacy_archive>

---

## 4. Tooling & Automation

<tooling>
- **tools/verify_gate.py** — Unified verification orchestrator running `--fast` (post-write gate) and `--full` (pre-turn completion battery).
- **tools/test_quick_sim.py** — CURRENT GATE: automated validation suite for `shared/QuickSimEngine.gd` (probability distribution properties, home advantage, manager/referee influence, ratings sanity).
- **tools/lint_invariants.py** — Domain-specific AST invariant linter enforcing layer separation and choke point contracts.
- **tools/lint_scope.py** — Postmortem AST scope linter catching duplicate variable declarations and dead code across function blocks.
- **tools/lint_type_comparisons.py** — Postmortem type safety linter preventing Object vs String/StringName equality comparisons.
- **tools/lint_stringnames.py** — StringName literal linter enforcing `&"string_name"` on signal and metadata invocations.
- **tools/lint_shadowing.py** — Parameter shadowing linter preventing collisions with member variables and autoload singletons.
- **tools/lint_allocations.py** — Allocation & distance-sorting linter enforcing `distance_squared_to()` and zero transient RNG instantiations.
- **tools/lint_signal_races.py** — Signal race condition linter enforcing state variable updates prior to signal dispatch.
- **tools/lint_xref.py** — Qualified-member access and `res://` path checker (included in the fast gate).
- **tools/tscn_linter.py** — Scene graph and resource resolver validating ext_resource paths, node hierarchies, and collision layer masks.
- **tools/verify_db.py** — JSON database schema and constraint verification.
- **tools/validate_schemas.py** — Strict JSON Schema and physical invariant validator for club databases.
- **tools/gdcheck.py** — Static GDScript checker enforcing typing, valid identifiers, and Godot 4.7 API compliance; also enforces the autoload boot order.
- **tools/replay_test.py** — Deterministic seeded simulation replay harness.
- **tools/fuzz_solvers.py** — Property-based mathematical solver fuzzer for shared math.
- **tools/benchmark_math.py** — Mathematical solvers micro-benchmark suite.
- **tools/generate_symbols.py** — Symbolic indexer generating `docs/SYMBOLS.json`.
- **tools/dump_api.py** — Public API surface extractor generating `docs/API_SURFACE.md`.
- **tools/dump_dep_graph.py** — Static dependency DAG builder and blast radius query tool exporting to `docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json`.
- **tools/codebase_slice.py** — Targeted code slicing CLI extracting functions, enums, signals, or class headers.
- **tools/semantic_search.py** — Zero-dependency local BM25 knowledge retrieval over rules, specs, and GDScript docstrings.
- **tools/compact_errata.py** — Errata compaction tool promoting discovered rules and archiving old session state.
- **tools/sync_rules.py** — Tool promoting rules from `AGENTS_ERRATA.md` to `.claude/rules/` and `docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md`.
- **tools/next_task.py** — Tool querying `ROADMAP.md` for the next unchecked task and relevant file context.
- **tools/layer_context.py** — Targeted context injector for simulation layers 1–3.
- **tools/football_mcp.py** — Local offline `football-expert` MCP server backed by `.agents/football_domain.db` (built by `scripts/build_football_kb.py`).
- **tools/mcp_server.py** — Standard stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agent tooling and introspection.
- **tools/lsp_client.py** — Godot Language Server Protocol client with local static diagnostic fallback.
- **graphify** — Knowledge graph extractor, query engine, and clustering CLI (`graphify query`, `graphify path`, `graphify explain`, `graphify update .`).
- **docs/GRAPHIFY_LIFECYCLE.md** — Canonical specification of Graphify build, update, git hooks, and enforcement matrix.

**Archived-engine tools (reference only, candidates for retirement):** `tools/eval_simulation.py`, `tools/fuzz_formations.py`, `tools/fuzz_utility_scorer.py`, `tools/formation_ascii.py`, `tools/dump_match_frames.py`, `tools/spatial_grid_bench.py`, `tools/audit_process_modes.py`.
</tooling>

---

## 5. Entry Flow & Career Match-Day Flow

<entry_flow>
- **Boot:** `project.godot` main scene `res://ui/SplashScreen.tscn`.
- **Menu:** `ui/MainMenu.tscn` — exactly three buttons: **Manager Mode**, **Options**, **Quit**.
- **Manager Mode:** `ui/manager_mode/ManagerCreationScreen.tscn` → `ui/manager_mode/ManagerModeRoot.tscn`.
</entry_flow>

<match_day_flow>
`ui/manager_mode/ManagerModeRoot.gd::_on_continue_pressed()`
→ `CareerManager.simulate_next_fixture()`
→ `QuickSimEngine.simulate_match()`
→ `CareerManager._apply_fixture_result()` updates league table, finances, morale, board confidence, player records and cup rounds.

A full season of matches resolves in seconds; the career UI never leaves `ManagerModeRoot`.
</match_day_flow>

---

## 6. Key Contracts (Where to Start)

- **autoloads/CareerManager.gd** — Career state + day loop and fixture dispatch (Layer 1).
- **autoloads/WorldEventLog.gd** — Club-world history → `PressOffice` (Layer 3).
- **shared/QuickSimEngine.gd** — Statistical match resolution (Layer 2).
- **shared/career/** — Career data model + engines.
- **shared/career/CareerSerializer.gd** — JSON save/load, 3 slots, versioned.
- **ui/manager_mode/ManagerModeRoot.gd** — FM-style career shell.
- **autoloads/GameEvents.gd** — Signal bus choke point.
- **.claude/rules/career-mode.md** — Career layer contracts.
- **tools/lint_xref.py** — Qualified-member + `res://` path checker.
